SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers)::FLOAT, 2) as yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy BETWEEN 14 AND 60 AND cls IN ('day_1_5')
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers)::FLOAT, 2) as yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy BETWEEN 85 AND 120 AND cls IN ('three_quarter', 'overnight')
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100
